contexts.text: Spheres... extend themselves into... Societies which are remote thence.
From those who are Churches in particular is constituted the Church in general.
This representative emanated... to remote nations.
The angelic Societies appear... remote from each other...
They sometimes see remote Societies... in the human form.
The Angels... have much hope of a nation remote from the Christian world, and thus remote from infesters.
The Spiritual World is... by no means remote from man.
As remote from man as the moon from the earth.
Far remote from the centre of the idea.
Many muscles remote from each other...
When there is no Church, the Angels are removed, so that an influx... is not possible into the Societies remote thence.
In this Earth... they have communication by ships with remote regions.
At a very remote place in the north...
When they are thinking about those remote in the city, they are presented...
They have their eyes... at remote mountains.
In cottages, (and) remote from each other.
Many have been present with me from... remote Earths.
2. 2. No one can enter... into a higher remote Society.
